description: Na₈Al₆Si₆O₂₅ crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.71 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There is one shorter (2.49 Å) and three longer (2.63 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.26 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.23 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.76 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.75 Å) and two longer (1.76 Å) Al-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four AlO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.64 Å) and one longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond length. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four AlO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.63 Å) and three longer (1.64 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are nine inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four Na atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom.
